title: Add live CLI coverage for peer self-revoke guard
summary: Cover the operator self-revoke guard through a real daemon and CLI subprocess by listing the operator token prefix, attempting `covenant peers revoke` without `--force`, verifying the CLI rejects it, and confirming the operator token still authenticates.
expectedFailureModes: The CLI self-revoke guard prints guidance in unit tests but allows the live daemon to revoke the operator token.
The live test extracts the wrong token prefix from `peers list` output.
A failed self-revoke attempt breaks subsequent operator authentication.
The test becomes part of default CI or depends on non-local services.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd live_cli_peers_self_revoke --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_peers_self_revoke --locked -- --ignored live_
humanEscalation: Approval before exercising `--force` against the operator token outside an isolated temp home
nextAction: Integrated locally; forced self-revoke recovery coverage should remain temp-home only and requires explicit approval before broader use.
